scope.summary: Expose a StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork as a typographic baseline (text on a path) and text-frame boundary (area type) for the Typography engine (14.7) via StudioTextStory/StudioTypeStyle — the vector domain owns ONLY the geometry and MUST NOT reimplement text layout; editing the geometry of a text-bound path (move anchors, reshape segments, reverse direction) reflows the bound text along the updated baseline without detaching the run, deleting the path follows the typography detach/relink contract, and geometry editing MUST NOT bake text to outlines as a side effect. Create-outlines produces standard vector geometry under this sub-section.
expected_tests: argus: text-on-path binding reachable via author_id
test: path usable as baseline + area boundary; geometry edit reflows text without detach; delete follows detach/relink; no implicit outline-baking; create-outlines yields vector geometry
acceptance_criteria_original: path as baseline/area boundary + reflow on geometry edit + detach/relink + no implicit outline-bake; author_id + manual entry

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Text on a path & create outlines

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-VEC-038]** A `StudioVectorPath`/`StudioVectorNetwork` MUST be usable as a typographic baseline (text on a path) and as a text-frame boundary (area type). The vector domain owns only the geometry; the text run, shaping, path-text options and area-type behaviour are owned by the Typography engine (14.7) via the `StudioTextStory`/`StudioTypeStyle` primitives. The vector domain MUST expose the path as a stable typographic reference and MUST NOT reimplement text layout. Converting text to outlines produces standard vector geometry under this sub-section.

**[STU-VEC-068]** Editing the geometry of a path bound to text (moving anchors, reshaping segments, reversing direction [STU-VEC-043]) MUST reflow the bound text along the updated baseline without detaching the text run, and deleting the path MUST follow the typography domain's detach/relink contract (14.7) rather than silently discarding the text. The vector domain MUST NOT bake text to outlines as a side effect of geometry editing.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.
